text: It has been an honor to serve as your Mayor. For more than 22 years, I have proudly served Lawndale as a Planning Commissioner, Councilmember, and Mayor, committed to protecting our neighborhoods, strengthening our economy, and improving our quality of life.

Together, we have attracted businesses including Target, Sprouts, Bossa Nova, Starbucks, Hirsch Pipe & Supply, WSS Shoes, and Mateo's, creating jobs and strengthening our economy. I will continue promoting quality housing, hotel development, and investment that expands city revenues.

I secured $6 million in state funding, including $2 million for road improvements, pedestrian safety and $4 million for a Youth Development Center. Working alongside residents, I successfully fought Metro's proposal to route a light rail line through our neighborhoods.

As your Mayor, I will continue prioritizing public safety, economic development, infrastructure improvements, services for seniors and youth, and preparing Lawndale for opportunities associated with the 2028 Olympics.

I'm proudly supported by first responders; Councilmembers Kearney and Cuevas; former Councilmember Rhonda Hofmann-Gorman; community leaders Chelsea Schreiber and Johnny Martinez; business owners, and residents.
On behalf of my wife, Léna, and our three daughters, thank you for your trust. I respectfully ask for your vote. I'm Pullen for You!

text: Serving as your City Councilmember has been one of the greatest honors of my life, and I respectfully ask for your vote to continue serving as your Mayor.

As a lifelong Lawndale resident, my wife, Mabel, and I have been married for 31 years and raised our three children here. My family has lived in Lawndale since 1958, when my grandfather bought the house where I was raised.

For more than 30 years, I served our community as an educator in the South Bay and in Los Angeles before being elected to the City Council. I am committed to ensuring Lawndale's continued financial stability, supporting public safety, improving infrastructure, and encouraging responsible economic development.
As Mayor, I will continue to provide honest, accessible, and fiscally responsible leadership focused on safe streets and neighborhoods, youth and senior services, and greater economic opportunity.

I believe in public service, a stronger community, and a brighter future. Together, we can build One Lawndale–Our Community, Our Future by listening to residents, working collaboratively, and making thoughtful decisions that strengthen our city for generations to come.
It would be an honor to earn your trust and your vote. Honored to Serve. Committed to You.
